title: DataspaceProtocolDistributionBase
description: Base distribution interface compliant with Eclipse Data Space Protocol, requiring a format and accessService.

@type.description:
The type identifier for the Distribution.
REQUIRED per Eclipse Data Space Protocol.

@id.description: Unique identifier for the distribution; optional for embedded distributions.

hasPolicy.description: Optional array of ODRL offers; when present, must contain at least one entry.

accessService.description: Access service URI or inline access service definition.

allOf.description:
Base interface for DCAT Distribution without JSON-LD context.
This is the context-free variant of IDcatDistribution, intended for embedding
distribution objects inline within datasets where the context is provided by the enclosing document.

@id.description: The unique identifier for the distribution object.

dcterms:title.description: A name given to the distribution.

dcterms:description.description: A free-text account of the distribution.

dcterms:issued.description: Date of formal issuance of the distribution.

dcterms:modified.description: Most recent date on which the distribution was changed, updated or modified.

dcterms:license.description: A legal document under which the distribution is made available.

dcterms:accessRights.description: Information about who can access the distribution.

dcterms:rights.description: Information about rights held in and over the distribution.

dcat:accessURL.description: A URL of the resource that gives access to a distribution of the dataset.

dcat:accessService.description: A data service that gives access to the distribution.

dcat:downloadURL.description: The URL of the downloadable file in a given format.

dcat:byteSize.description: The size of the distribution in bytes.

dcat:spatialResolutionInMeters.description: The minimum spatial separation resolvable in a distribution, measured in meters.

dcat:temporalResolution.description: Minimum time period resolvable in the distribution.

dcterms:conformsTo.description: An established standard to which the distribution conforms.

dcat:mediaType.description: The media type of the distribution as defined by IANA.

dcat:compressFormat.description: The compression format of the distribution.

dcat:packageFormat.description: The package format of the distribution.

spdx:checksum.description: The checksum property provides a mechanism to verify the data integrity.

allOf.$comment: Inlined utility base type DcatDistributionBase so utility transformations can operate on concrete properties instead of a $ref.
